'''Aedwin Cole''' is a crewman aboard the ''[[Spray]]''.

==History==
He is from northern [[Altara]] or northern [[Murandy]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Aedwin Cole}}

==Activities==
During the beginning of the troubles at [[Falme]], Aedwin Cole wants to cast off from the city. His captain, [[Bayle Domon]], doesn't allow him to cut any of the lines, hoping that [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]], and [[Min Farshaw]] will make it aboard.{{ref/book|2|46}}
